description: Stop what the apply AI is doing, the same as the user pressing Stop in the app: with taskId, only that conversation stops (in one-click apply that application also leaves this run); without it, the same as "Stop all" on the application list (running ones stop now, queued ones are not applied to) plus every other running conversation. Filled pages stay as they are; send_job_apply_instruction can have it continue later. Replies with the state read back after stopping. Requires the AceRound Auto Apply desktop app on the user’s computer to be signed in and open (running in the background after closing the window also works); if the app is offline or outdated, the tool says so. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:write.)
name: stop_job_apply_task
